column1: # Corpus garbage interception filter — `(code, word)` pairs that
# must NOT enter `weights.tsv` when regenerating from upstream
# corpora.
# Purpose (long-term design call 2026-06-03 per user directive
# "我不认为我们的源码中还应该存在有别人来源命名的 corpus，导入过程
# 应该是落在'吸收'，在那时候就要做好去重、解决冲突以及拦截垃圾"):
# upstream corpora (jieba phrase tables, SUBTLEX, mozc, etc.) ship
# with noise that polish-log has flagged as wrong. Instead of
# letting that noise re-enter `weights.tsv` every time
# `pinyin-build-weights` regenerates from corpora, this file holds
# the running list of "we already judged this garbage, do not
# re-admit". The absorption pipeline (not yet wired) will consult
# this filter before writing a row.
# This file does NOT participate in the polish-rebuild chain — it
# is consumed only at full corpus regen time. Today, when a polish
# action does a D1 delete (remove the row from weights.tsv
# directly), we ALSO append a row here. The dual-record keeps the
# delete idempotent across future regens.
# Format:
#   <code>\t<word>\t<reason_date>[\t# longer note]
# Status: PLACEHOLDER 2026-06-03. The pinyin-build-weights wiring
# to consult this file is corpus-治理 phase work, scheduled for
# the next regen cycle. For now this is an audit log of D1
# decisions; populating it preserves the intent.
# 2026-06-03 user: "次贫 可意 不存在" — both jieba sub-word noise
# (literal char concat, not real Chinese words). Deleted from
# weights.tsv at commit `2a65806`.
